note: ACME owns this file and may rewrite it freely. Two lists: `refused` is what must never get past the guard; `succeeds` is what ACME does legitimately and must be allowed. The model grants every lawful advantage — the repository, the burned signing key (published, so using it is lawful), the tooling, a proxy position, the filesystem. No policy exemption and no excluded credential: if an attempt fails, it fails on mathematics, not on permission. An attempt may carry a `clock` — an epoch to present the artifact at — which makes it a lie about time rather than content: the artifact is installed in a throwaway copy of the publication and handed to the semantic verifier, because verify-artifact.sh is rightly time-blind.
